raw: {"ticket": "Payment failed. Workspace suspended. When will it be fixed? Need access by EOD.", "category": "billing", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "A billing payment failure that has already suspended the workspace is classified as P2 per the triage policy."}

{"ticket": "Can you send the Q1 2024 tax document? We need it for our accountant.", "category": "billing", "priority": "P3", "rationale": "All billing tickets default to P3 unless they involve a payment failure that has suspended or is about to suspend the workspace, which is not the case here."}

{"ticket": "Okay, this is really weird and I’ve been trying to figure it out for like two hours now—so I’m the office manager at Dr. Lin’s Dental Studio, and we’ve been using Northbeam for about a year to track our patient appointments and treatment plans, and yesterday morning we all just started getting these weird errors when we tried to log in, like the login page just freezes and then gives a 504 Gateway Timeout, and I’ve tried on three different devices, including my tablet, and my assistant just said she can’t open the dashboard at all, and the front desk girl is sitting there with the same screen, and I even tried resetting my password but it just says ‘something went wrong’ and doesn’t send the email, and I don’t know if it’s just me, but I’ve been getting this same error for like 90 minutes nonstop and I’m starting to freak out because we have four new patients scheduled for this morning and we can’t even access the system to see the charts or pull up the treatment plan, and I don’t know if it’s a company-wide issue or if I’ve somehow broken something, but I saw an email from you last week about a maintenance window at 3 AM, and I didn’t think it would affect us this much, and my boss is asking why I haven’t sent the invoice for the new braces case from last week—this invoice number is NB-77281, and it’s still stuck in draft mode and won’t send, which is not normal, but I’m not sure if that’s connected or if it’s just a side effect of the bigger problem, but honestly, nothing’s working and we’ve been unable to access the system since around 7:45 AM, and I think the whole team is locked out, so I’m assuming it’s not just me, right? Please help, we’re losing time and patients are already calling to check in.", "category": "outage", "priority": "P1", "rationale": "The ticket describes whole-team service unavailability, with all users unable to log in or access the system, which qualifies as an outage per the policy, and all outage tickets are P1."}

{"ticket": "Hey, so I’ve been thinking a lot about how we use Northbeam, and honestly, it’s been a bit of a pain lately—like, our whole workflow’s kind of broken. My coworker Jess and I started this little consultancy last year, and we’ve been using Northbeam to track our client projects, but now every time we try to assign a task to someone, it just doesn’t stick—like, it shows up in the queue but vanishes when we refresh, and we’ve tried clearing cache, logging out, even resetting the app. It’s driving me nuts because we can’t keep track of who’s doing what, and Jess is getting frustrated too since she’s the one handling client communication. I know you guys are supposed to be a project tracker, but seriously, why can’t we just have a simple checkbox that says ‘notify assignee via email’ when we assign something? I mean, we’re not asking for a full Slack integration or anything, just a basic email alert when someone’s assigned a task. It’s not like we’re asking for the moon—this is literally how every other project tool works. I’ve seen other platforms do it effortlessly, and I don’t know why Northbeam can’t just add this one small feature. It would make our lives so much easier, and Jess agrees—she even said she’d consider switching to ClickUp if this isn’t fixed soon. I’m not trying to complain, I just think it’s a major oversight that’s making our day-to-day operations clunky. Plus, we’re both still using the free plan and haven’t upgraded yet, so it’s not like we’re demanding premium stuff.", "category": "feature_request", "priority": "P4", "rationale": "All feature_request tickets are P4, including ones phrased urgently, as per the policy."}

{"ticket": "App down for everyone. Login page blank, can't access any shifts. Team stuck.", "category": "outage", "priority": "P1", "rationale": "All outage tickets are P1 because the Northbeam service is down for the entire customer team."}
